formation_predicate.value: Maintain the latest three completed bars. Bullish formation requires middle close > middle open and last low > first high. Bearish formation requires middle close < middle open and last high < first low. The gap must meet min_gap_atr against the formation ATR and the middle body must be at least 0.20 ATR.

formation_vs_confirmation.value: The first bar supplies the origin edge, the middle bar is the impulse bar, and the third/latest completed bar supplies the non-overlap confirmation and detection event.

lawful_known_available_time.value: bar_close_ts(i)=CompletedBar.end_ts(i) is the temporal boundary, not the earliest availability coordinate. The linked aggregator emits CompletedBar only when the first later source tick enters a different event-time bucket; for a normal completed bar, available_time = received_ts_ns(boundary-crossing source tick), with source_sequence as the equal-receipt tie-break. End-of-stream forming bars have no synthetic availability row and are excluded from this sidecar.

zone_identity.value: A monotonically increasing zone_id identifies each active zone in detector state; bullish direction and origin_ts, impulse_ts, detection_ts are persisted.

zone_bounds.value: Bullish bounds are lower=first high and upper=last low. Bearish bounds are lower=last high and upper=first low.

first_touch.value: The first later bar whose range overlaps the zone emits fvg_first_touch; touch_basis is bar_range_overlap and touched is latched.

fill.value: A bullish zone fills when a later bar low reaches the lower edge; a bearish zone fills when a later bar high reaches the upper edge. fill_basis is wick_reaches_far_edge.

invalidation_and_persistence.value: Zones remain active while the far edge has not been reached, are retained across subsequent bars, and are serialized/restored with the v4.2 state envelope.

lifecycle.value: Lifecycle is formation -> active zone -> optional first touch -> filled/removed. No separate cancellation event is declared; far-edge reach removes the zone after fvg_filled emission.

native_scale_behavior.value: Each configured timeframe is a separate bar-detector runtime and a separate Parquet stratum. FVG formation, touch, and fill semantics apply independently within the row's timeframe.

future_touch_fill_leakage_restrictions.value: Formation payload is emitted before any later touch/fill processing for the active zones; touch and fill are emitted only on subsequent processed bars. Later touch/fill fields are not part of the formation payload.

cross_scale_identity.value: The producer defines no cross-scale identity or merge operation. The lawful native-stratum identity is (timeframe, zone_id); cross-scale joins and identity claims are prohibited rather than left implicit.

parameter_identity.value: The linked generator constructs every bar DetectorConfig with an empty DetectorParams map. FVG therefore uses the code-frozen default min_gap_atr=0.20 at the linked producer commit; no external FVG parameter is supplied by the frozen generator path.

limitations: AR-01's assigned artifact was not present locally; linkage was taken directly from the frozen XAUUSD manifest.
No Trinity-side commit was named by the frozen lake manifest, so Trinity-side compatibility is unresolved and not used for authority promotion.
The artifact records source authority and declared dependencies only; it does not inspect behavioral outcomes or prove a fresh replay equivalence.
SHA-256 was not recomputed for the two separate micro-liquidity files in this artifact; their immutable Git blob identities are recorded instead of fabricating file hashes.
